question: The Parsi reform movement Rahnumai Mazdayasna Sabha was founded in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1851**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rahnumai Mazdayasna Sabha** was founded in the year **1851**.
 
• This movement was initiated by the **Parsi community** in India.
 
• The main aim was to **reform the social and religious practices** of the Parsi community.
 
• It focused on promoting **education, social welfare, and religious reform**.
 
• The movement played a significant role in the **modernization** of the Parsi community.
 
• Key figures associated with this movement include **Dadabhai Naoroji** and **Naoroji Furdunji**.
 
• The movement also sought to **abolish outdated customs** and encourage the adoption of more rational practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji**__

 __
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji** was a prominent Indian political leader and one of the founding members of the **Indian National Congress**.
 
• He was known as the **Grand Old Man of India**.
 
• He was the first Indian to be elected to the **British Parliament**.
 
 
 
• **Naoroji Furdunji**__
 
 
• **Naoroji Furdunji** was an influential Parsi social reformer and one of the key figures in the **Rahnumai Mazdayasna Sabha**.
 
• He worked towards the **abolition of child marriage** and promotion of **education for women**.
